scope.proofBoundary: Local source, builds, deterministic tests, isolated processes, development package and installer dry-run; no live Editor/model verification

claimInterpretation: ByDesign describes the approved implemented contract, not a claim that the original defect was intentional. P2 records implementation review priority; it is not an unresolved-defect list.
existing: Existing note snapshot and reference contracts
Markdown guidance generator and existing CI suites
doNotDuplicate: No semantic model judge or extra agent
No second mutation authority derived from archived evidence
invariants: Retain first-consumer raw evidence until actual input delivery or explicit recovery handling.
Display omission cannot invalidate retained notes; failed snapshots preserve prior notes.
Scope/lineage/version and source/body/envelope offset units remain distinct.
All serialized tool responses obey the total response budget; legacy formats remain readable.
Cancellation before publication prevents effects; after publication outcomes reflect confirmed effects or uncertainty.
External Editor timeout is not termination proof and must not start a competing writer.
Lexical observation, build result, provider success and semantic task completion remain distinct.
No live settings, installed runtime, game project, git branch or release are changed by this turn.
